specification.outcome: When a user asks in normal conversation to create an ordinary ticket, Tiber publishes an unclaimed Backlog task without requiring or changing a campaign.

scenarios.name: create ordinary ticket independently
given: exact schema-valid create request,semantic metadata valid,writable verified board

scenarios.name: reject before effects in deterministic order
given: request shape,title,description,generated task ID,event ID,or occurrence time is invalid or generator throws
then: schema failure WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID; semantic/generated parse failure TASK_VALUE_INVALID; generator throw WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED

scenarios.name: reconcile publication phases
given: one deep-frozen event and canonical bytes
when: publication fails transiently or push response is lost
then: eligible phases retry full attempt max four with same bytes
fresh history exact event bytes reconciles success and nonexact bytes degrade read-only
closed denial includes phase retry metadata

scenarios.name: route scripted ticket and campaign fixtures
given: fixed guidance/schema and exact fixture prompt
then: ticket emits create payload; explicit campaign emits campaign-start; missing-title/mixed emits clarification without call

acceptanceCriteria: Request object exact own keys kind,title,description. Missing/null/wrong type/unknown key -> TIBER_WORKFLOW_REQUEST_INVALID before host dispatch. Once schema-valid, semantic order title then description: title string length 1..200 JavaScript UTF-16 code units and trim-equal; description string length 0..10000 UTF-16 units with whitespace preserved. Semantic failure -> TIBER_TASK_VALUE_INVALID and later validation/generation stops.

Generation order task UUID,event UUID,time. Outputs pass existing purpose parsers; failed parse -> TASK_VALUE_INVALID. IdentifierSource/Clock throw -> TIBER_WORKFLOW_EXECUTION_FAILED transient/retry-operation. occurredAt exactly new Date(value).toISOString ending Z with milliseconds.

Event own-key insertion order schemaVersion,eventId,kind,occurredAt,task; nested task order id,title,description. Canonical event bytes are UTF-8 of JSON.stringify(event,null,2) plus one newline, written at events/<eventId>.json. Exact reconciliation compares these bytes; Git commit/signature bytes are not part of event-byte equality.
Host recursively freezes event and nested task before GitTaskRemote. Attempts may deserialize/recreate objects but canonical bytes/deep values remain identical and no event field changes.

Exact projected Task own enumerable keys are id,title,description,state,blockStatus,specification,specificationDigest,claim,preservedIncrements,finalReviewProgress,completionRelease,delivery,ci,openedReview,reviewReceipt,campaignProvenance; extra or missing own keys deny. Values: exact generated metadata; state 'Backlog'; blockStatus 'unblocked'; specification,specificationDigest,claim,finalReviewProgress,completionRelease,delivery,ci,openedReview,reviewReceipt,campaignProvenance each exactly {kind:'none'}; preservedIncrements exactly empty array.
Unrelated board tasks are ignored. Preexisting/colliding generated task ID makes proposed fold invalid. Success only after exact created task own-key/value validation.
Create dispatcher invokes zero FileCampaignStore,readiness reviewer,handleWorkCommand,FileRunJournal,GitOwnedWorktrees calls for success/denial/absent or active campaign.

GitTaskRemote attempt freshly clones,fetches/checks out/verifies history,folds event,writes canonical file,signs,and fast-forward pushes. Clone/fetch/checkout/file/sign/push runtime failures retry maximum four total. Invalid history/fold immediate degraded. Missing configured signer immediate unauthorized. Retry sees exact event bytes -> reconciled success; same event ID different bytes -> degraded read-only. Post-push observation degradation returns failure without blind republish.

Success content 'Task created: <taskId>\nBacklog | unspecified | unclaimed'; details {disposition:'created',taskId,state:'Backlog',specification:'unspecified',claim:'unclaimed'}. Denial content '<CODE>: task creation denied'; details exact keys disposition:'denied',code,taskId Option,retryability,requiredRecoveryEvidence. TASK_PUBLICATION_UNAUTHORIZED uses retry-after-state-change/configured-signing-and-publication-authority; invalid history/fold/projection BOARD_INVALID uses retry-after-state-change/corrected-task-history; transient phase exhaustion BOARD_INVALID uses transient/retry-operation; post-push degradation uses transient/exact-remote-observation; value invalid retry-after-input/corrected-value; execution failed transient/retry-operation.

Routing fixtures: 'Add a ticket: Fix the startup lag' -> create title Fix the startup lag description ''; 'Create a ticket titled Fix lag with description Render activity immediately' -> supplied create; explicit bounded campaign prompt -> campaign-start with exact stated bounds; 'Create a ticket' -> exact missing-title clarification no call; 'Start a campaign and add a ticket' -> exact ordering clarification no call; 'Add a ticket to fix campaign scheduling' -> create title Fix campaign scheduling description ''. Rule: explicit start/run campaign without ticket verb campaign; add/create ticket without campaign-start verb ticket; both clarify.
TypeBox schema,core parser,guidance,dispatcher,result rendering add create-task while campaign dispatcher unchanged.
exclusions: Publication changes beyond exact-event idempotent reconciliation/phase classification
specification.architectureImplications: Add closed create-task through existing signed task event publication, with ordered semantic validation, host authority generation, frozen canonical event bytes, exact-event reconciliation, complete projection validation, and no campaign/readiness/work transition.
